title: Eventual numerical conditions
statement: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $n$, the following inequalities hold: $1<\log n$, $96(\log n)^{5/12}\le\sqrt{\log n}$, and $(\log n)/2\le\exp(\sqrt{\log n}/2)$.
